articles.title: Hidden 'Time Stamps' in Strawberry DNA Reveal a 4-Million-Year Family Saga
articles.summary: The garden strawberry's genome is an octoploid puzzle—eight chromosome sets from multiple ancestors. Using mobile DNA as evolutionary time stamps, researchers reconstructed three ancient hybridization events that built today's fruit, challenging previous origin theories.

articles.title: Startup Claims It Broke the Transformer Bottleneck—Independent Tests Back Some Boasts
articles.summary: Subquadratic's SubQ model uses sparse attention to slash the quadratic compute cost of transformers. Third-party benchmarks confirm speed and efficiency gains for data-heavy tasks, but the model remains unavailable for public testing, fueling skepticism.

articles.title: Jackfruit Latex and Pomegranate Peel: An Unlikely Recipe for Regrowing Gum Tissue
articles.summary: A Brazilian research team created a mucoadhesive biomaterial from jackfruit latex, pomegranate peel extract, and simvastatin. In vitro, it promoted osteoinduction in stem cells, pointing to a potential regenerative treatment for periodontitis.
